实现

Section3

#!sage
def attack(N, e, beta, delta):
    N = int(N)
    e = int(e)
    if 3*beta+2*delta > 1-log(4, N):
        print('[-] Attack failed')
        return None
    else:
        X = int(pow(N, delta))
        Y = int(pow(N, (beta+delta)))
        Bp = matrix(ZZ, [[N*X, 0], [e*X, -Y]])

        print('[+] LLL reduction...')
        sv = Bp.LLL()[0]

        c = sv*Bp ^ -1
        c1 = -abs(c[0])     # k
        c2 = abs(c[1])      # q*dp
        q = abs((e*c2+c1*N)//(c1+1))
        p = N//q
        print('[+] Attack successed')
        print('[+] p = {}'.format(p))
        print('[+] q = {}'.format(q))
        return p, q
